    Category cocycles and the map Ψ (toward Proposition 12.5) #

    A Hochschild two-cocycle φ of the category C of internal degree q gives the first-order deformation of C; restricted to the projective corner it is a cocycle μ of A₀, and its other restrictions are lifts of the actions on the evaluated modules (ν(m, a) = φ(a, m)) and of the arrow maps (g_a(m) = φ(m, a)). The mesh error of these lifts is Σ_a c_{x,a} φ(σa, a) (Ψc_catLift): this is how Ψ reads off the class of the deformation (deformation-refinements.tex: "Evaluation of every object at those projectives gives a free lift of its normalized module").
